concerns.text: Task T012e (Low Power Warning) depends on T012b (Raw Record Count), but T012b is marked as unimplemented (checkbox empty). T012e cannot execute without the artifact produced by T012b, creating a broken dependency chain for the metadata aggregation flow.

Task T012h (Success Criterion SC-001) depends on T012b and T014. T014 (Filter Records) is unimplemented. T012h cannot calculate the proportion of valid labels without the filtered dataset from T014, blocking the final metadata aggregation (T012g).

Task T024 (Semantic Embeddings) depends on T001 (Setup) and T016 (Cleaned Dataset). T016 is unimplemented. T024 cannot run without the cleaned dataset artifact, breaking the US2 feature extraction flow.
Task T025 (Save Feature Matrix) depends on T024b and T029. T024b (Cosine Similarity) and T029 (Collinearity Check) are unimplemented. T025 cannot execute, blocking US2 completion and US3 dependency.
Task T033 (Adaptive Data Splitting) depends on T025 (Feature Matrix). T025 is unimplemented. T033 cannot execute, blocking the entire US3 modeling phase.

Task T001b (Dependencies) and T002 (Dependency Pinning) are redundant and both depend on T001a. T002 is marked as completed but duplicates T001b's description. Consolidate to a single task to avoid confusion in the execution order.

Tasks T000a and T000b are verification gates with no implementation artifact. While they block the pipeline, they do not produce data artifacts consumed by subsequent tasks. Ensure the pipeline runner treats these as 'pass/fail' gates rather than 'producer' tasks to avoid false dependency chains.
